MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The USB extension cables fit my pattern of making existing equipment easier to use: they would let me connect my card reader and other USB accessories without reaching behind devices.",
    "The Fire TV Stick offers a plausible new use for my television by adding streaming, although its 4K capability adds no benefit to my 720p set."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The USB C cables serve a familiar charging purpose, but their connectors do not match the Micro USB and older Apple connections in my history.",
    "The Ring charger depends on battery packs I have not shown a need for, while the mesh network and wall plates assume network coverage or installation projects I have not indicated.",
    "The Echo devices, earbuds, and security cameras introduce uses I am not currently pursuing. My photography accessories and GPS mounts do not imply a need for home surveillance or voice assistants."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My purchases seem to have been read as broad interest in electronics, when many were specific accessories for equipment I already use.",
    "Owning a Fire tablet and buying car accessories seems to have been stretched into interest in Alexa devices at home and in the car."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "Connector type and compatibility matter to me: a cable is useful only if it connects the equipment I actually have.",
    "My repeated purchases of memory cards, mounts, chargers, and storage cases suggest practical support for existing devices, rather than a current desire to start a new device setup.",
    "A related purpose still needs a concrete reason: extending access to my card reader is useful now, while routing cables through a wall would require a separate project."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly recognized my interest in useful device accessories, but too often expanded it into unrelated electronics without a clear compatibility or immediate-use connection."
}
